milestones.caption: An arranged union guided by Allah and blessed by our families. June 19 was the memorable day our eyes met, we talked for the first time, and our Kabin was signed.

loveMessage: Our story began on June 19, 2026 when our families brought us together. From our first conversation on our Kabin day to our shared dreams of Hajj, Umrah, and adventure trips, every step forward is written with love.
bengaliQuote: ১৯ জুন থেকে শুরু আমাদের যৌথ পথচলা... হজ্জ, উমরাহ আর হাজারও স্বপ্নের পানে! 💛
reasons: The peaceful feeling when we met and talked for the very first time on June 19 during our Kabin.

Your excitement for future ghuraghuri travel trips across beautiful nature paths 🌿.

The way we can build all our future adventures from scratch together.

Because you are my wife, my partner in faith, and my forever adventure companion.

lockedChamber.title: Just For My Oaeshi 🔒
lockedChamber.content:
Dearest Oaeshi (my bby, my wife),

When our families brought us together and we met and talked for the first time on June 19, 2026, my heart felt a quiet peace. That day, our Kabin was sealed, and our true journey began.

All our greatest adventures are still waiting ahead of us—standing side by side in Makkah for Umrah and Hajj, going on spontaneous ghuraghuri travel trips, adopting a little kitten for our home, and laughing together late at night.

I promise to honor our sacred vow, respect you, protect your happiness, and walk this trail with you forever.

With all my love,
Khabbab 💛
